dict.string: Better Vorssaint uses Automation to move files in Finder, send items to the Trash and open Terminal commands when you ask for Homebrew actions.
Better Vorssaint taps individual app audio only to adjust each app's volume in the mixer. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Better Vorssaint uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Better Vorssaint records your microphone only when you turn it on for a screen recording. The audio stays on your Mac unless you choose to create a temporary link.
Better Vorssaint shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Better Vorssaint checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose.
Better Vorssaint organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads in a destination folder you explicitly choose.
